title: Digest emails ignore the user's unsubscribe flag
current: Users with email_digest_opt_out = true still receive the weekly digest; the sender only checks the account-level 'emails enabled' switch.
expected: A user who opted out of the digest never receives it, whatever the account-level switch says.
business_impact: High - unwanted emails to users who opted out (complaints, spam reports, possible compliance issues).
root_cause: The digest job builds its recipient list from the account setting and never reads the per-user opt-out flag.
why_today: (inferred) The per-user flag was added after the digest job; the job's query was never updated.
why_not_prod: (inferred) Few users have opted out so far, so the volume is small and nobody has noticed yet.
customer_impact: Users who opted out keep getting the digest.
suggested_fix: Filter recipients on email_digest_opt_out = false in the digest job query; add a test with an opted-out user.
existing_notes: Evidence: 3 of 3 opted-out test users received the digest on staging.
